name: Skill-Box
description: An collection of practical skills that transforms your AI assistant from a generalist into a powerful specialist.

plugins.name: anthropic-brand-guidelines
plugins.description: Applies Anthropic's official brand colors and typography to any sort of artifact.

plugins.name: raffle-winner-picker
plugins.description: Picks random winners for giveaways, raffles, and contests.

plugins.name: data-analysis-toolkit
plugins.description: Complete data analysis toolkit: CSV summarization, pivot tables, and variance analysis for comprehensive business data insights.

plugins.name: financial-modeling-suite
plugins.description: Professional financial modeling suite for DCF valuation and LBO analysis. Perfect for investment banking and corporate finance.

plugins.name: invoice-processor
plugins.description: Automatically process invoices from PDFs/images to Excel using AI vision.
plugins.curatedNote: 自建技能，日常用于批量处理发票和报销单据，从 PDF/图片自动提取关键字段到 Excel，显著减少手工录入时间。

plugins.name: content-harvester
plugins.description: Complete content harvesting: download videos, extract YouTube transcripts, and fetch WeChat articles.
plugins.curatedNote: 日常高频使用的内容采集三件套：weixin-fetch 抓微信公众号文章（Playwright 反爬）、yt-dlp 下载视频、YouTube 字幕提取。是内容工作流的基础设施。

plugins.name: content-research-writer
plugins.description: Assists in writing high-quality content with research, citations, and section feedback.

plugins.name: notebooklm-integration
plugins.description: Query Google NotebookLM notebooks for source-grounded answers.
plugins.curatedNote: 深度文档分析的生产力利器。支持直接在 Claude 中查询 Google NotebookLM 笔记，回答均基于信源并有引用支持，极大提升了处理海量资料的效率。

plugins.name: anthropic-frontend-design
plugins.description: Anthropic's official tools for professional UI design and dynamic artifact construction.
plugins.curatedNote: Anthropic 官方出品的前端设计与 Artifacts 构建工具。其提供的设计系统是构建高质量、跨平台交互界面的核心基石。

plugins.name: vercel-frontend-suite
plugins.description: Premium React development and deployment suite from Vercel Labs: best practices, design guidelines, and instant deployment.
plugins.curatedNote: Vercel Labs 官方出品的前端工程化套件。集成了 React 最佳实践与 Vercel 自动化部署能力，特别适合快速原型开发与线上发布。

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Streamline development: brainstorm features, push changes, and auto-generate changelogs.

plugins.name: skill-creator
plugins.description: Guide for creating and updating effective Claude skills.
plugins.curatedNote: Anthropic 官方的技能创建指南。每次为 Skill Box 开发新技能时的必备参考，确保 SKILL.md 结构和 frontmatter 规范一致。

plugins.name: mcp-builder
plugins.description: Guide for creating high-quality MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.

plugins.name: developer-growth-analysis
plugins.description: Identify coding patterns and growth areas from chat history.

plugins.name: document-suite
plugins.description: Complete office document toolkit: create, edit, and analyze Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF.
plugins.curatedNote: Anthropic 官方的办公文档处理全家桶。处理 Word/Excel/PPT/PDF 的首选技能，生成报告和数据表格时频繁调用。

plugins.name: markdown-to-epub-converter
plugins.description: Convert markdown documents and chat summaries into EPUB ebook files.

plugins.name: file-organizer
plugins.description: Intelligently organizes files and folders by understanding context.

plugins.name: obsidian-visual-suite
plugins.description: Complete visualization toolkit for Obsidian: Excalidraw, Mermaid, and Canvas.

plugins.name: algorithmic-art
plugins.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness.

plugins.name: canvas-design
plugins.description: Create beautiful static visual art and posters.

plugins.name: image-enhancer
plugins.description: Improves quality of images/screenshots by enhancing resolution and clarity.

plugins.name: slack-gif-creator
plugins.description: Toolkit for creating animated GIFs optimized for Slack.

plugins.name: theme-factory
plugins.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with preset or on-the-fly themes.

plugins.name: baoyu-content-creation-suite
plugins.description: Complete content creation workflow: AI image generation, multi-platform publishing (Xiaohongshu/WeChat), article illustrations, slide decks, comics, and infographics.
plugins.curatedNote: 宝玉出品的多平台内容创作全流程套件。小红书配图、微信发布、文章插图、幻灯片、漫画、信息图一站式覆盖，配合 Gemini Web 和 AI 图片生成能力，是内容创作者的核心工具箱。

plugins.name: baoyu-compress-image
plugins.description: Batch compress images and optimize file sizes.

plugins.name: remotion-best-practices
plugins.description: Comprehensive guide for Remotion video creation: React-based video production, animations, audio, captions, 3D content, and 46 best practices.

plugins.name: supabase-postgres-best-practices
plugins.description: Postgres performance optimization and best practices from Supabase: query performance, schema design, connection management, and security.

plugins.name: data-visualization-suite
plugins.description: Scientific data visualization and analysis toolkit: Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly for charts, GeoPandas for geospatial, NetworkX for network analysis, and SymPy for symbolic math.

plugins.name: financial-data-research
plugins.description: Financial and SEC research toolkit: SEC EDGAR filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K), US Treasury fiscal data, hedge fund risk monitor, and real-time market data via Alpha Vantage.

plugins.name: podcast-generator
plugins.description: Generate AI podcasts with dual-speaker dialogue using Volcano Engine TTS. Supports multiple audio formats, adjustable speech rate, and streaming reception.

plugins.name: github-cli
plugins.description: GitHub operations via gh CLI: manage issues, PRs, CI runs, code review, and API queries with structured JSON output.

plugins.name: skill-seekers
plugins.description: Powerful universal preprocessor that turns docs, repos, and PDFs into structured AI knowledge assets/skills.

plugins.name: obsidian-toolkit
plugins.description: Premium agent toolkit for Obsidian: Markdown mastery, Bases (databases), JSON Canvas, CLI automation, and clean web extraction with Defuddle.
plugins.curatedNote: Obsidian 创始人 kepano 官方出品。涵盖 Obsidian Markdown 语法、Bases 数据库视图、JSON Canvas、CLI 自动化和 Defuddle 网页提取，是 Obsidian 用户的权威技能包。

plugins.name: productivity-toolkit
plugins.description: Essential productivity integrations: Notion knowledge management, Trello project boards, nano-pdf natural-language PDF editing, and real-time weather queries (no API key needed).

plugins.name: audio-content-suite
plugins.description: Audio and speech toolkit: OpenAI Whisper API for transcription, offline local TTS via sherpa-onnx, and URL/file/YouTube summarization with summarize.sh.

plugins.name: video-frames-toolkit
plugins.description: Video frame and thumbnail extraction using ffmpeg for visual analysis and content creation.

plugins.name: x-social-publisher
plugins.description: Publish and manage X (Twitter) posts, replies, and media via xurl CLI with full API access.

plugins.name: jina-cli
plugins.description: Reads web content and searches the web using Jina AI Reader API. Use when extracting content from URLs, reading social media posts (X/Twitter), or web searching for current information.
plugins.curatedNote: 最强大的网页内容结构化工具。基于 Jina AI Reader，能够将任意网页、推文甚至 GitHub 仓库瞬间转化为纯净的 Markdown 格式，是 Agent 获取实时知识的“眼睛”。

plugins.name: md-to-pdf
plugins.description: Convert Markdown files to PDF with CJK font support, image embedding, and batch processing. Use when asked to convert markdown to PDF, 转换为PDF, or batch convert MD files.
plugins.curatedNote: 日常高频使用的 Markdown 转 PDF 工具。完美支持中文字体和图片嵌入，支持单文件和批量转换，是内容输出的最后一环。
